hook.name: GoldFunHook
hook.description: Memecoin launchpad hook implementing a constant-product bonding curve for token launches. During the curve phase, swap math is fully overridden and fees (protocol + referral + creator) are skimmed from the ETH side. At graduation, raised ETH and unsold tokens are seeded as locked full-range liquidity in the same pool. Post-graduation, the hook collects the same fee split from normal AMM swaps via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas.
